# Limit

Lets only N envelopes through, unchanged: the first N as they arrive (top) or the last N when the input ends (bottom). Handy to test a flow on a sample. Last 1 is a barrier: one envelope goes on only after every component before it finished with every envelope (e.g. to advance a checkpoint or release a lock once); nothing goes on when no envelope arrives.

- Type: `limit` (Transformation)
- Inputs: `in-0`
- Outputs: `out-0`
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: none (writes into DATA)
- Override: no
- Writes outside the run: no

## Settings

| Key     | Label     | Kind   | Required | Default | Notes                  |
| ------- | --------- | ------ | -------- | ------- | ---------------------- |
| `mode`  | Keep      | select |          | `"top"` | one of `top`, `bottom` |
| `count` | Envelopes | number |          | `10`    | 1 to 1000000           |

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
mode: top
count: 10
```
